description.zh: 要给普通参数添加的描述信息。长度限制为200字符。
description.en: The description of the common parameter. The description must be 1 to 200 characters in length.

description.zh: 参数名称。取值范围：内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度不能超过200字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD、OOS开头。
description.en: The name of the common parameter. The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). It cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS.
The tags to be added to common parameter.
The value of the common parameter. The value must be 1 to 4,096 characters in length.

title.zh: 更新一个已存在的普通参数

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos update-parameter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MyParameter --value update --description update --tags k1_:_v1_,_k2_:_v2 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxsn4m4000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos UpdateParameter --region cn-hangzhou --Description update --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxsn4m4000000' --Value update --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Tags 'k1_:_v1_,_k2_:_v2' --Name MyParameter
